text: じっくり　そだてると　いいぞ！

structure.jp: じっくり　そだてると
structure.en: if you raise it without hurrying

patterns.name: 〜といい
patterns.explanation: A verb followed by といい is a friendly piece of advice: it would be good to do this. そだてるといい = 'you should raise it'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end makes the statement strong and confident, in a rough male way of talking. いいぞ = 'it's good, I tell you!'
